images.caption: 24,000 + adult trial. Finding: combined aerobic and resistance training produced the greatest HbA1c reduction of any single exercise category. It will do no good to do 90-min/wk. 300-min was twice significant vs 150-min. Plateau over 300. More sessions vs one long better. training in the 2 to 6 pm window (insulin sensitive timing) was better than morning.
adipocyte-adiponectin - hormone that helps with weight control that gets messed up with too much viscerel fat.
